surfaces_note: one switch moves all of these at once — they share one credential store, so the UI must show them together

liveness.optional_note: absent from credentials written by the VS Code extension bundle; a missing value means UNKNOWN, never CLOSED

identity.plan_note: NOT claudeAiOauth.subscriptionType, which read 'team' for a Max 5x account

companion.note: keys absent from the incoming profile are deleted, not left holding the previous account's identity

policy.warn_note: The refresh window is NOT a constant: 3.55 days measured on macOS/Max 5x, 28.3 days on Linux/Team. A fixed threshold is therefore wrong under one regime or the other, so CLOSING is computed as a fraction of this blob's own window, with a floor so a very short window still warns at all.

login.hint: Run 'claude' in a terminal, then /login. Use a terminal rather than VS Code — the extension may still hold a handle on the profile.
